# Job Config Chain v0.1.2

Second release of **Job Config Chain**, a Jenkins plugin for job-scoped configuration management. It keeps structured config (JSON, XML or YAML) in shared, versioned Config Sets plus per-job overrides, and keeps that store in sync with `#{Dotted.Path}#` placeholder tokens in your application's config file (for example `appsettings.json` or `application.yml`). It validates drift before a deploy and substitutes the real values at deploy time. Everything lives under `$JENKINS_HOME`: no external database, no git-backed store.

This release follows the second round of the Jenkins hosting review (PR #7). It **removes the old step names and URLs** (see *Breaking changes* below), narrows the job page to Pipeline jobs, and tidies the Manage Jenkins layout.

> Not yet listed on plugins.jenkins.io — hosting request in progress (jenkins-infra/repository-permissions-updater#5307); install manually.

## Breaking changes since v0.1.1

- **Old step names are gone, with no aliases.** `configTemplateValidate`, `configTemplateSubstitute` and `setupConfigTemplate` no longer exist. Use `configChainValidate`, `configChainSubstitute` and `setupConfigChain`.
- **Old `/configTemplates` URLs are gone.** Use `/configChains` (global) and `/job/<name>/configChains` (per job).

Update your Jenkinsfiles and any bookmarks before upgrading.

## Highlights

- **Versioned Config Sets** — named configs in JSON, XML or YAML, with a change note per version and one active version; history is append-only.
- **Base chain + job override** — a job builds on an ordered chain of common Config Sets (following the active version or pinned to one) and applies its own override last, merged with RFC 7396 Merge Patch (arrays are replaced wholesale, never merged element by element).
- **Structural drift validation** — `configChainValidate` fails the build when the file has a `#{Path}#` token with no matching key, and warns about unused keys.
- **Version history and rollback** — roll back by re-activating an older version; history is never rewritten.
- **Build-pinned config replay** — every real substitution records a Deployment Binding (the exact versions used), so `redeployFromRun` replays an older build's config byte-identically.
- **Secrets stay in Jenkins credentials** — secret leaves are bound to a Jenkins credential ID; stored content only ever holds a placeholder, never a real value.
- **Native Jenkins UI** — a *Config Chains* page globally (`/configChains`) and per job (`/job/<name>/configChains`), with a Monaco-based editor. The Manage Jenkins pages now use the wide `l:settings-subpage` layout.
- **Pipeline jobs only** — the per-job page and job property are available on Pipeline (`WorkflowJob`) jobs, including multibranch branch jobs, because the configuration is consumed by Pipeline steps. Freestyle jobs are not supported.
- **Cleaner Snippet Generator** — `configKey` is shown only when `useBase` is checked.
- **Localized** — 34 locales.

## Install

| Platform / Method | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Jenkins ≥ 2.568.3 — **Manage Jenkins → Plugins → Advanced settings → Deploy Plugin** | `job-config-chain.hpi` | Upload the file and restart if prompted. Required plugins (installed with it if available): Credentials, Plain Credentials, Pipeline: Step API, Pipeline: API, Pipeline: Job, Ionicons API, Gson API, SnakeYAML API. |

## Pipeline steps

| Step | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `configChainValidate` | Fails if the file has tokens with no matching key (drift); warns about unused keys. |
| `configChainSubstitute` | Replaces every `#{Path}#` token in the file and records a Deployment Binding. |
| `setupConfigChain` | Declares `file` and the resolution parameters once for the rest of the build. |

Parameters: `file`, `useBase`, `configKey`, `version`, `redeployFromRun`, `encoding`.

```groovy
configChainValidate(file: 'app.json')
configChainSubstitute(file: 'app.json')
```

## What has been verified

- **1018 automated tests**, including characterization tests of the 5 core processes, upgrade/replay tests of builds recorded by older versions, restart-durability of in-flight builds, and redeploy replay.
- **Real-browser checks** of the UI in light and dark themes.
- **Content Security Policy enforced** — the UI runs under Jenkins' CSP.
- **34 locales** covered by parity tests, so no locale is missing keys.

## Known limitations

- Not yet hosted on the Jenkins Update Center; install manually until the hosting request completes.
- The release and version format will switch to Jenkins CD after hosting.
- The Monaco editor's own widgets (find, context menu, and similar) stay in English.
- Translations other than Ukrainian are machine-assisted, not native-reviewed.
- The Russian locale shows Ukrainian text by design.
- Freestyle jobs are not supported; the job page and property exist on Pipeline jobs only.

See the [README](https://github.com/Retro-kharkov1/job-config-chain#readme) and [Getting started](https://github.com/Retro-kharkov1/job-config-chain/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md) for the full walkthrough.
